title: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd - 544447 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Smartworks Q2 FY27 revenue rose 39% YoY to INR 591 crore; FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 33-35% from 28-30%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations reached INR 591 crore, up 39% YoY and 8% QoQ, the sixth straight quarter of sequential growth since listing. Normalised EBITDA was INR 117 crore at a 19.8% margin (up 340 bps YoY), and normalised PAT was INR 43 crore (up 136%). Management raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 33-35% and kept the normalised EBITDA margin guidance at 19-20%, trending to the upper end. Operating cash conversion was weak at 0.9x OCF/EBITDA and free cash flow was negative at about INR 104 crore for H1, as capex and deposits for not-yet-open campuses ran ahead of revenue.

financial_highlights.change: up from INR 5,400 crore last quarter

segments.name: Rental revenue (mature centres)
segments.commentary: Mature centres of about 9.7 million sq ft are 88% occupied and 91% committed, so management says near-term rental uplift must come from new campuses. Large enterprises contribute 91% of rental revenue.

segments.name: Other operating revenue
segments.commentary: Grew about 125% YoY on a small base; VAS revenue rose from about INR 70 crore to INR 170 crore in H1 (sources of growth: ancillary services, Smart Vantage, FaaS and value-added services). Management expects it to grow at least in line with footprint.

segments.name: Singapore
segments.commentary: Four centres with about 1,600 seats at around 86% committed occupancy.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 33-35% from 28-30%; implies H2 revenue of about INR 1,250-1,280 crore per analyst calculation.
FY27 normalised EBITDA margin guidance kept at 19-20%, with management expecting the upper end for the rest of the year.
Operational footprint guided to 12.5-13 million sq ft by March 2027; management said close to 11 million sq ft is operational now.
FY27 capex guidance INR 550-600 crore, with INR 307 crore spent in H1; H2 weighted to Eastside (Pune) and East Bridge (Mumbai).
ROCE guided to reach about 28% by FY28.
Plans to add 2.5-3 million sq ft a year, funded internally; FCF expected to turn positive as the mature base approaches 13 million sq ft, in the next few quarters.
capex_capacity: Platform at 17.5 million sq ft across 71 centres; 10.9 million sq ft across 58 centres operational; about 1 million sq ft added in H1 FY27.
About 4.3 million sq ft under fit-out or awaiting handover, against 1.6-2.1 million sq ft needed to go live by March (per CEO); CFO cited 2.1 million under fit-out and 2.3 million awaiting handover.

About 45,000 seats to open in H2 FY27, mostly at Eastside (Pune) and East Bridge (Mumbai); East Bridge awaits its OC and will start build-out only after it arrives; about 35% pre-fill at these campuses.
Capex per sq ft about INR 1,350-1,400 before inflation, with about 4.5-5% inflation factored in; management says costs are holding near that level.
About INR 200 crore of capex and security deposits sits in centres not yet open, about one-fifth of capital employed.
Supply for FY28 largely secured; FY29 supply under way; 4.5 million sq ft committed but not expected to be live in FY27.
demand_pricing: Overall occupancy about 81% (lower end of the 80-85% band); committed occupancy about 86%; new campuses 48% committed.
Management guides mature-centre occupancy at 88-90%, with time to reach about 90% below 18 months; blended occupancy may dip below 80% in H2 as large campuses open.
Average seat price about INR 8,200 per year, roughly INR 300 a day; escalations of 4-5% a year are contracted; repricing of COVID-era leases is adding to realisations.
GCCs are 22% of rental revenue; management expects 35-40% of incremental rental growth from GCCs. Top-10 clients are about 24% of rental revenue, up from about 20% a year ago.
Industry context per CBRE: 66.4 million sq ft leased in first nine months of 2026, up 8% YoY; flex operators took 24% of office leasing in Q3 CY26 (July-September); flex is 14-15% of office stock.

qa_highlights.question: Pre-leasing status and stabilisation timing for Eastside and East Bridge.
qa_highlights.answer: About 35% pre-fill is visible, mostly from existing clients in BFSI, manufacturing and logistics, with some IT/ITES. East Bridge needs its OC before build-out of 3-4 months, so meaningful revenue is expected around late Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What drives H2 revenue growth and what levers support the margin above 20%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said lease rental uplift from mature centres is limited at 91% committed, so most new rental revenue comes from campuses opening late in the year. Other operating revenue (VAS, Vantage, FaaS) also contributes; margin levers include operating leverage, cost savings, 5-6% annual escalations and future FCF/other income.

qa_highlights.question: Will occupancy trend towards 84-85% or stay around 81%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects mature-centre occupancy at 88-90% within 18 months and blended occupancy trending towards 84-85% as the portfolio matures over about four quarters. Committed occupancy (86% overall, 91% mature) is the more relevant measure.

qa_highlights.question: Why is other operating revenue up 125% and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Growth reflects a small base and new verticals (Smart Vantage, VAS, FaaS). Management said other operating revenue should grow at least in line with footprint growth, since ancillary services are table stakes.

qa_highlights.question: Capex per sq ft and maintenance capex.
qa_highlights.answer: Capex is about INR 1,350-1,400 per sq ft before inflation, with 4.5-5% inflation factored in. Maintenance capex is 12-15% of initial gross block a year, about INR 95-100 crore this year.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ROCE flat at 21.6% a peak, and when does FCF turn positive?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ROCE is expected to reach about 28% by FY28 as new campuses mature, and FCF should turn positive as the mature base approaches 13 million sq ft, in the next few quarters.

risks_watch: Cash conversion: reported OCF/EBITDA at 0.9x and H1 FCF of about negative INR 104 crore; management expects it to stay below 1x in H2 while deposits are paid.
Campus delivery timing: East Bridge needs its OC before fit-out; management flagged possible delays of a quarter or two on some properties.
Blended occupancy may dip below 80% in H2 as about 45,000 seats open; committed occupancy is the metric management wants tracked.
Revenue guidance back-end loaded: much of the H2 uplift depends on campuses billing from February-March.
Pricing and realisation: rental growth relies partly on mix and repricing of older leases, which will take a year or two to flow through.
Keppel holds about 15% stake; management says there is no immediate monetisation plan.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, guidance and the margin trajectory, and explicit that short-term ratios (occupancy, cash conversion, ROCE) will look soft during the heavy capex phase. Management repeatedly framed the dips as timing effects from new campuses and gave specific figures to back them. Some answers were long and repetitive on demand themes rather than the specific questions asked.
key_quotes: Revenue is growing every quarter. Profitability is growing with it.
We are investing today in supply that is scarce to serve demand that is not.
We are not building Smartworks for the next quarter. We are building it for the next decade.

adds.what: About 45,000 seats to open in H2 FY27 at Eastside (Pune) and East Bridge (Mumbai)
Operational footprint to 12.5-13 million sq ft by March 2027 (from ~10.9-11 million sq ft operational now)

growth.why: Management raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 33-35% (from 28-30%) with the H2 step-up backed by ~10.9M sq ft operational, a 12.5-13M sq ft target by March 2027 and ~4.3M sq ft under fit-out/handover against 1.6-2.1M needed to go live, though East Bridge still awaits its OC and new campuses are only 48% committed.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Normalised EBITDA margin at 19.8% in Q2 (+340 bps YoY) and H1 at 19.7%, with management guiding FY27 at 19-20% and trending to the upper end, aided by 4-5% contracted escalations and operating leverage.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 45,000 seats are set to open in H2 FY27 at Eastside and East Bridge, and footprint is guided to rise from ~10.9M to 12.5-13M sq ft by March 2027, with ~4.3M sq ft under fit-out or handover against 1.6-2.1M needed to go live.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Operational footprint is guided up about 18% to 12.5-13M sq ft by March 2027, and H1 revenue grew 41% YoY, though new campuses are only 48% committed and mature centres are 88% occupied.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is about 81% and management plans 2.5-3M sq ft a year funded internally, but FY27 capex of INR 550-600 crore is already committed and no new capex programme was announced on the call.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance was raised to 33-35% from 28-30%, but the H2 step-up is back-end loaded on campuses billing from February-March and East Bridge still awaits its OC.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management flagged possible delays of a quarter or two at some properties, and East Bridge cannot start 3-4 months of build-out until its OC arrives, so late-year revenue is at risk.

rows.label: Cash conversion and FCF turn positive
rows.why: H1 FCF was about negative INR 104 crore with OCF/EBITDA at 0.9x, and management expects it to stay below 1x in H2 while deposits are paid, with FCF turning positive as the mature base nears 13M sq ft.

rows.label: Repricing of COVID-era leases and escalations
rows.why: Average seat price is about INR 8,200 a year with 4-5% contracted escalations, and repricing of older leases is adding to realisations, though it will take a year or two to flow through.

rows.label: Contracted rental revenue growth
rows.why: Contracted rental revenue rose to about INR 5,800 crore from INR 5,400 crore last quarter (about +7% QoQ), and GCCs are expected to deliver 35-40% of incremental rental growth.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand, the raised revenue guide and the margin trajectory, and openly flagged soft occupancy, cash conversion and ROCE during the capex phase; analysts pressed on campus delivery timing, the back-end loaded H2 and when FCF turns positive.
